subject: Can't finish onboarding flow
description: New trial users keep getting stuck at the workspace setup step. They never reach the dashboard.

subject: Activation email never arrives
description: Signup confirmation works but the activation email is delayed by hours. People forget the product exists.

subject: Month 2 churn spike
description: Several customers cancel in their second month. They say the value is unclear after the first month.

subject: Setup wizard too complex
description: The onboarding wizard asks for 9 fields. Sales team reports prospects abandoning mid-setup.

subject: No way to invite teammates during onboarding
description: Users want to add their team while setting up but the invite step is buried after billing.

subject: First run is confusing
description: Logged-in users describe the first screen as overwhelming. No guided tour for analytics views.

subject: Export blocked without a template
description: Users cannot export reports until they create a template. Unclear error message.

subject: Trial activation at 12%
description: Only 12% of trials reach the active state. Growth team wants a fix before the Q2 push.

subject: Push notifications not supported on iOS
description: Marketing wants push alerts for new reports but iOS support is missing.

subject: Digest email goes to spam
description: Weekly digest lands in spam for 20% of users. Engagement with digests is low.

subject: Billing page confusing
description: Upgrade path requires contacting sales. Mid-market customers expect self-serve.

subject: Slack integration missing
description: Ops teams ask for report alerts in Slack. We have none.

subject: Slow dashboard loading
description: Analytics dashboard takes 8+ seconds with 10k rows. Users open it once and leave.

subject: Error on report generation
description: Report generation crashes for large date ranges. Stack trace points to aggregation service.

subject: GDPR data retention unclear
description: EU customers ask how long their data is stored. We cannot answer.

subject: SSO setup takes days
description: Enterprise prospects stall at SSO configuration. Sales loses deals in evaluation.

subject: Deprecation of legacy CSV export
description: Legacy CSV export is broken since the API v2 migration. Customers rely on it for finance.

subject: Can't kill legacy dashboard
description: Team wants to sunset the old dashboard but 300 customers still use it weekly.

subject: Onboarding email link dead
description: The onboarding email links to a removed page. New signups hit 404.

subject: No NPS follow-up
description: Detractors never get a follow-up. We lose the chance to save at-risk accounts.

subject: Reports too slow to render
description: Rendering reports with filters takes 30 seconds. Users believe the product is broken.

subject: Team seats confuse admins
description: Admin cannot see who consumed seats. Upgrade friction for champions.

subject: API rate limits undocumented
description: Integrators hit undocumented rate limits and blame our API. Retry guidance missing.

subject: Churn reason survey ignored
description: Exit survey responses are collected but never analyzed. Churn reasons are anecdotal.
